primary.title: The Advancement of Learning
primary.author: Francis Bacon
primary.rationale: A foundational work of Bacon's philosophy, outlining his ideas on the classification of knowledge and the scientific method. Widely available.

primary.title: Novum Organum
primary.author: Francis Bacon
primary.rationale: Bacon's most famous work, presenting his inductive method for scientific inquiry. A key text in the history of science.

primary.title: Essays
primary.author: Francis Bacon
primary.rationale: A collection of short, influential essays on a wide range of topics, demonstrating Bacon's prose style and practical wisdom. Frequently reprinted.

secondary.title: The Cambridge Companion to Bacon
secondary.author: Markku Peltonen
secondary.rationale: A comprehensive collection of essays by leading scholars covering various aspects of Bacon's life, work, and influence.

secondary.title: Francis Bacon: A Very Short Introduction
secondary.author: John Henry
secondary.rationale: A concise overview of Bacon's life and thought, suitable for an introduction to his work.

secondary.title: Francis Bacon: Philosopher of the Scientific Revolution
secondary.author: Peter Urbach
secondary.rationale: An academic study focusing on Bacon's role and contributions to the Scientific Revolution.

suggestions.notes: Francis Bacon's works are foundational to early modern philosophy and science, and are widely available in digital archives. Secondary sources are readily available from major academic publishers.
